# northflank_addon_backup_schedule (Resource)

Schedules backups of an addon, such as a daily dump of a PostgreSQL database.

Northflank cannot change a schedule, so changing any attribute replaces it. An addon can have one schedule per interval and backup type. Destroying the schedule stops new backups; existing backups are kept until their retention time passes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "northflank_addon" "db" {
  project_id      = "my-application"
  name            = "main-db"
  type            = "postgresql"
  version         = "18"
  deployment_plan = "nf-compute-20"
  storage_size    = 8192
}

# A dump of the database every day at 03:00, kept for 14 days.
resource "northflank_addon_backup_schedule" "db_daily" {
  project_id     = northflank_addon.db.project_id
  addon_id       = northflank_addon.db.id
  backup_type    = "dump"
  interval       = "daily"
  hours          = [3]
  minutes        = [0]
  retention_days = 14
}

# And a weekly one on Sundays, kept for 12 weeks.
resource "northflank_addon_backup_schedule" "db_weekly" {
  project_id       = northflank_addon.db.project_id
  addon_id         = northflank_addon.db.id
  backup_type      = "dump"
  interval         = "weekly"
  days             = [6]
  hours            = [4]
  minutes          = [0]
  retention_days   = 84
  compression_type = "zstd"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `addon_id` (String) ID of the addon to back up.
- `backup_type` (String) `dump`, a logical export of the data, or `snapshot`, a copy of the addon's storage. Which types an addon supports depends on its type.
- `interval` (String) `hourly`, `daily` or `weekly`. `daily` needs `hours`; `weekly` needs `hours` and `days`.
- `minutes` (Set of Number) Minutes past the hour at which to back up, from 0 to 59.
- `project_id` (String) ID of the project the addon belongs to.
- `retention_days` (Number) How many days each backup is kept.

### Optional

- `compression_type` (String) Compression of `dump` backups, `gz` or `zstd`. Northflank uses `gz` when it is not set. Not allowed for `snapshot`.
- `custom_destination_id` (String) ID of a custom backup destination, such as an S3 bucket added to the team, to store the backups in instead of Northflank's own storage.
- `days` (Set of Number) Days of the week on which to back up, from `0` (Monday) to `6` (Sunday). Required for `weekly`, not allowed otherwise.
- `hours` (Set of Number) Hours of the day at which to back up, from 0 to 23 (24-hour clock). Required for `daily` and `weekly`, not allowed for `hourly`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the schedule, assigned by Northflank.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Backup schedules are imported as <project_id>/<addon_id>/<schedule_id>. The
# schedule IDs of an addon are listed by
# GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/addons/{addonId}/backup-schedules.
terraform import northflank_addon_backup_schedule.db_daily my-application/main-db/62cc20b90956ab62a58e8474
```
